rules.title: Strict mode
rules.text: Enable "strict" in tsconfig and keep it on.

rules.title: No any
rules.text: Do not use any; use unknown and narrow, or model the type properly.

rules.title: Prefer unions over enums
rules.text: Prefer string literal unions over enums.

rules.title: Validate external data
rules.text: Validate untrusted data at runtime with a schema library instead of casting.

rules.title: Avoid non-null assertions
rules.text: Avoid non-null assertions (!) and unchecked type assertions (as).

rules.title: Readonly by default
rules.text: Use readonly and as const for data that should not change.

rules.title: Discriminated unions
rules.text: Model variants with discriminated unions and exhaustive switch checks.

rules.title: satisfies over assertions
rules.text: Use satisfies to check shapes without widening types, instead of as.

rules.title: Explicit exported return types
rules.text: Declare return types on exported functions.

rules.title: No ts-ignore
rules.text: Do not use @ts-ignore; use @ts-expect-error with a reason only when unavoidable.

rules.title: Checked indexed access
rules.text: Enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess and handle undefined from index lookups.

rules.title: Explicit module settings
rules.text: Keep module and moduleResolution consistent with the runtime and bundler.

rules.title: Avoid as casts
rules.text: Avoid as casts. Use a type guard or a narrow helper with a stated reason when a cast is unavoidable.

rules.title: exactOptionalPropertyTypes
rules.text: Enable exactOptionalPropertyTypes so optional properties mean missing, not undefined.

rules.title: No require()
rules.text: Use ES module import syntax. Do not use require() in TypeScript sources.
